meta.title: DSH Chief
meta.description: Right-sidebar plugin for DSH: tracks task progress, saves notes before context compaction, and asks before editing your workspace. Read-only by default.

observer.title: 👁 Read-Only Observer
observer.desc: Read-only: no automatic actions or edits; gives summaries and advice when asked.

collab.title: 🤝 Daily Co-Pilot
collab.desc: No background model calls while idle; steps in on errors or blocked walls and asks before important changes.

away.title: 🚀 Away Managed
away.desc: Keeps watching progress, auto-compacts at 80%, stops after 30 calls or 300K tokens, and sends alerts at key points.

ledger.title: 📊 Chief LLM Ledger & Hard Budget Cap
ledger.tripped: 🛑 Hard budget cap reached — auto-stopped to protect tokens
